result.title: AITHER: Authority-Informed Evidence Routing for Mixed-Authority Vision-Language Reasoning
result.summary: Reliable vision-language reasoning requires a control decision that conventional grounding methods leave implicit: which input is entitled to determine the answer? Auxiliary text may be a defeasible claim about an image, a binding task instruction, or compatible context. Correcting every image-text conflict toward the image therefore repairs false claims but overwrites valid task rules. We formalize this setting as mixed-authority vision-language reasoning and introduce AITHER, an Authority-Informed Text-Image Hierarchy for Evidence Routing. Its final policy, the Semantic-Frame Router, is a training-free black-box control layer that (i) compiles explicit task directives, (ii) recovers standardized spatial frames from metadata-scrubbed pixels, (iii) resolves the semantic polarity of remaining notes, and (iv) routes among frozen observable candidates with fail-closed semantics. This ordered decomposition converts authority arbitration from an unconstrained prompt preference into a reproducible inference program. Across 1,620 MATRIX predictions, AITHER reaches 95.1% accuracy, exceeding the strongest task-and-frame baseline by 9.1 points with a 95% record-cluster interval of 6.8-11.5 points and no harmed records. It further reaches 100.0% on 1,800 controlled FRAME predictions and 93.3% on GQA-MATRIX. The results show that explicit authority routing can simultaneously improve false-claim correction, preserve task-defined answers, and eliminate clean-context overcorrection.

AI.brief_summary: 论文形式化「混合权威」视觉语言推理：判断图像、可推翻的文本声明与绑定式任务指令中哪一方有权决定答案，并提出免训练的 AITHER 语义框架路由器，按指令编译、空间框架恢复、语义极性判定和失败即关闭的候选路由四步做权威仲裁。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心是「答案该由视觉证据还是文本/指令决定」，直接关联 LVR 中视觉旁路、证据筛选与答案是否真正使用视觉内容的诊断，其分步路由与 fail-closed 规则可供核查推理期证据选择的设计。
